panels.title: Instances reporting
panels.description: Instances that sent metrics in the last 2.5 minutes. 0 means the service is down or cannot reach the collector.

targets.expr: count((go_goroutine_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(go_goroutine_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: HTTP requests per second, health probes excluded.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that failed on the server side (HTTP 5xx, or the gRPC server error codes).

targets.expr: (sum (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: 99% of the requests were faster than this.

panels.title: CPU / limit
panels.description: CPU used over the container's CPU limit (Kubernetes): the Go runtime does not report CPU itself.

panels.title: Runtime memory
panels.description: Memory the Go runtime uses: heap, stacks and runtime structures.

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Connections in use over the pool maximum. At 100% new operations wait for a connection.

targets.expr: sum((db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="used"} unless time() - timestamp(db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="used"}) > 150)) / sum((db_client_connection_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(db_client_connection_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150))

panels.title: Error logs (5 m)
panels.description: Log lines at error level or above in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Starts in range
panels.description: Times the service logged that it finished starting in the selected range. More than one per instance means it restarted.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restart count of the service's containers (Kubernetes). It grows on crashes, OOM kills and failed liveness probes.

panels.title: Containers ready
panels.description: Containers passing their readiness probe (Kubernetes).

panels.title: Starts over time
panels.description: Each point is a completed start: find when the service restarted, then read the startup log next to it.

panels.title: Startup log
panels.description: The lines a start produces: configuration, connections, migrations, listeners, and the failure when it did not come up.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} |~ `telemetry initialized|connected to mongodb|consuming rabbitmq events|HTTP server listening|application failed|shutting down|shutdown|bootstrap rabbitmq`

panels.title: Kubernetes events
panels.description: Events of the service's pods: scheduling, image pulls, failed probes, BackOff, OOMKilled. A crash before the service could send its logs only shows up here; read its output with kubectl logs --previous.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that failed on the server side.

panels.title: By route
panels.description: Rate, error ratio and p99 of each route over the last minutes.

targets.expr: (sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CPU and memory of the containers (Kubernetes)
CPU
panels.description: CPU cores each pod uses, with the container's request and limit. At the limit the container is throttled.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of each pod: what the OOM killer compares with the limit.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Receive above zero, transmit below.

panels.title: Memory by type
panels.description: Memory in use by type. The next garbage collection starts when the heap reaches the GC goal.

targets.expr: sum by (go_memory_type) ((go_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(go_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150))

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: A count that only grows is a goroutine leak.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Heap bytes allocated per second: the work handed to the garbage collector.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: In use, idle and the pool maximum. Waiting operations mean the pool is exhausted.

targets.expr: sum((db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="used"} unless time() - timestamp(db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="used"}) > 150))

sum((db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="idle"} unless time() - timestamp(db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="idle"}) > 150))

panels.title: Pool in use
panels.description: At 100% every new operation waits for a connection.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum((db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="used"} unless time() - timestamp(db_client_connection_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", db_client_connection_state="used"}) > 150)) / sum((db_client_connection_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} unless time() - timestamp(db_client_connection_max{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}) > 150)))

panels.title: Wait for a connection p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: How long an operation waited to get a connection. It should stay near zero.

panels.title: Connection timeouts
panels.description: Operations that gave up waiting for a connection.

panels.title: Failed messages by queue
panels.description: Messages whose handling failed after the retries: they went to the queue's DLQ.

panels.title: Processing time p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Time to handle a message, retries included.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: Log volume by level. A jump in error or warn is usually the first sign of a problem.

panels.title: Most frequent errors
panels.description: Error messages (first 100 characters) by how often they were logged in the selected range.

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Warn level and above. Open a line to see its trace id and jump to the trace in Tempo.

panels.title: All logs (filter with Log search at the top)
panels.description: Every log line of the service. Type in Log search to filter; the match is case-insensitive.
